messages:
Maya (CSM): quick weekly pulse for AcmeCo — token burn + throughput check. WoW token burn up ~18%, QoQ up ~6%. latency mostly stable but morning spike 8–9am PST. error rate up ~0.4pp. tagging @rahul + @zoe for numbers and logs. what do we think?
Rahul (CS Ops): numbers: WoW tokens 1.18M (+18%), QoQ 3.9M (+6%). avg latency 120ms (baseline) -> morning p95 ~210ms. 5xx increased 0.6% -> 1.0%. est spend +22% WoW. host: prod-us-east (hosted). dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/acct/acmeco/overview
Zoe (Data Eng): quick look at traces — lots of KV-cache misses for multi-prompt flows. p95 jumps line up with batching flush at ~8:15. will drop the query + snippet.
Zoe (Data Eng): ```sql
-- top callers last 24h, grouped by route
select route, count(*) as calls, avg(tokens) as avg_tokens, p95(latency_ms) as p95_latency
from public.requests
where account_id = 'acmeco' and ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
group by route order by calls desc limit 10;
```
Maya (CSM): is this on Dedicated or Hosted? any config we can recommend before enablement? :thinking_face:
Rahul (CS Ops): hosted on redwood-medium-1q (quant). pattern = webhook bursts at 07:50–09:30 PST. suggestion: prewarm cache for common prefixes + relax batching window during burst to reduce tail latency. also consider short-term burst capacity bump.
Tom (CS Ops Lead): we should run an enablement w/ them — 30m to walk batching/cache and show Console alerts. @Maya can you book 30m this week? also flag renewal risk if spend trend continues.
Maya (CSM): booked Thu 11:00am PT. action items: 1) prewarm cache for top 5 routes, 2) add regression alert for 5xx > 0.8%, 3) monitor token burn daily for 3 days after changes. @zoe plz add alert, @rahul pls coordinate infra if we need burst capacity.
Zoe (Data Eng): done — alert created (alert-bot id: a1b2c3). dashboard snapshot: https://console.redwood.ai/d/alerts/acmeco/a1b2c3/snapshot.png
Rahul (CS Ops): will request burst capacity for Thu test, ETA EOD to confirm. also preparing a short script to prewarm prefixes. snippet: `./prewarm.sh acmeco --routes /chat,/complete --parallel 4`
AcmeOps (Customer): thanks team — we'll try to smooth our webhook retries and reduce concurrency on our side Thu morning. appreciate the help :pray:
Maya (CSM): noted — I'll capture enablement notes and feedback in onboarding doc and send summary after Thurs. next check-in Fri EOD.
alert-bot: Monitoring: 5xx rate alert set to 0.8% threshold for acmeco (created by Zoe).
Maya (CSM): tiny follow-up — renewal touchpoint: if spend stays > +15% WoW for 2 weeks, mark as potential risk and loop AE.
Tom (CS Ops Lead): ack. I'll review renewal flagging thresholds and update playbook. :thumbsup:
Rahul (CS Ops): confirming — will post update in thread once infra confirms burst bump.
Zoe (Data Eng): will also add a short-run evaluation to track quality changes after prewarm (sanity for dedup & hallucination).
Maya (CSM): thanks all — good cadence.
